tagline: Technology in the service of family bonds

login.noAccount: I don't have an account, sign up
login.haveAccount: I already have an account, sign in

invite.title: Join a family

forgot.sent: If this address matches an account, an email has just been sent. Remember to check your spam folder.
forgot.mailNotConfigured: Email sending is not configured on this server. Please contact your installation administrator.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.tooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
reset.missingToken: Incomplete reset link. Please open the link you received by email.

errors.expired: This sign-in has expired. Please try again.
errors.invalid_code: This sign-in has expired. Please try again.
errors.account_conflict: An account already uses this email address. Sign in with your password and link single sign-on from Settings, or ask the family owner.
errors.identity_in_use: This identity provider account is already linked to another OpenFamily account.

errors.session_mismatch: You were signed in as someone else when the link started. Sign in again and retry.

errors.email_required: Your identity provider did not share an email address, which is needed to create your account.
